info.name: Lists DKIMs for an email domain.

params.name: emailDomainId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the email domain to which this DKIM belongs.

params.name: id
params.description: A filter to only return resources that match the given id exactly.

params.name: name
params.description: A filter to only return resources that match the given name exactly.

params.name: limit
params.description:
For list pagination. The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a
paginated "List" call. `1` is the minimum, `1000` is the maximum. For important details about
how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: page
params.description:
For list pagination. The value of the opc-next-page response header from the previous "List" call.
For important details about how pagination works,
see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either ascending or descending order.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: Filter returned list by specified lifecycle state. This parameter is case-insensitive.

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
Specifies the attribute with which to sort the DKIMs.

Default: `TIMECREATED`

* **TIMECREATED:** Sorts by timeCreated.
* **NAME:** Sorts by name.
* **ID:** Sorts by id.

info.name: Creates a new DKIM for an email domain.

items.docs:
Creates a new DKIM for an email domain.
This DKIM signs all approved senders in the tenancy that are in this email domain.
Best security practices indicate to periodically rotate the DKIM that is doing the signing.
When a second DKIM is applied, all senders seamlessly pick up the new key
without interruption in signing.

Deletes a DKIM.
If this key is currently the active key for the email domain, deleting the key
will stop signing the domain's outgoing mail.
DKIM keys are left in DELETING state for about a day to allow DKIM signatures on
in-transit mail to be validated.
Consider creating a new DKIM for this domain so the signing can be rotated to it instead of deletion.
